{{Quote|You familiar with the Terror Brigade? Group of ex-Mandalorian clans, all crazy as a snow cat with heatstroke&hellip; This Terror Brigade is always looking for a new combat thrill, unarmed ambushes, wrestling wampas, they've done it all.|Lieutenant [[Calia]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Terror Brigade''' was a group of illicit thrill-seekers composed of former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], who settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Terror [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]] was responsible for capturing an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] by the name of [[Yoren]], whom they offered to turn over to the custody of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] if a Republic representative could survive a series of [[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|combat challenges]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Terror Brigade appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies in the Heroic mission "The Terror Brigade" on Hoth for Republic players.<ref name="TOR" />
